meta.description: Planner builds your school's timetable under constraints, tells you why a session cannot be placed, keeps every version, and exports it as a PDF or into everyone's calendar.

entete.accroche: You describe your rooms, teachers, groups and rules. Planner places the sessions, and tells you why when it cannot.

calcul.texte: Planner looks for the best possible week: hard rules are always kept, soft rules as far as possible.
points: Teachers, visiting lecturers included, and their availability
Lectures, tutorials and labs that follow their groups
Several campuses, with the travel time between them
Hard rules and soft rules, set by the school

refus.texte: When a session cannot be placed, Planner names the rule that blocks it. You fix the data or relax the rule, then run the calculation again.

avis.label: Example of a Planner notice for a session that could not be placed
avis.texte: Biology lab: the teacher is not available on Tuesday morning.

cartes.texte: Every calculation is kept. You go back to an earlier version whenever you want.
The timetable becomes visible when the administration publishes it, not before.
The teacher asks, the registrar approves, and the students concerned are notified.
The timetable exports as a PDF, on the school's own time-slot grid.
Everyone subscribes their calendar to their timetable: changes show up on their own.
The timetable can also be sent by email.

illustration.label: Example of a week calculated by Planner, with one session not placed and the reason why
